verdict.rationale: Twilio is a programmable voice platform, so ring-group routing is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows generic building blocks: responding to and recording incoming calls, and a user-built voicemail-to-webhook setup. Nothing documents sequential or simultaneous ring groups, or failover of unanswered calls to voicemail or another number.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can ring a group in order or simultaneously, and route unanswered calls to voicemail or another number
